jobs.description:
Job Description

LX Project Manager | Location:
Canada (Remote) | Full-Time

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized LX Project Manager
to lead the successful delivery of learning experience and business transformation projects. This role is responsible for managing projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery aligns with scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards while providing an exceptional client experience.

As the primary day-to-day client contact, you will collaborate closely with internal teams and stakeholders to drive project success, proactively manage risks, and ensure client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Manage projects from initiation through closure in alignment with PMO lifecycle standards, including kick-off, planning, execution, reporting, retrospectives, and project closeout.
Serve as the primary liaison for clients, ensuring clear communication, stakeholder engagement, and overall client satisfaction.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, resource allocation plans, and delivery milestones.
Apply approved AI-enabled tools and digital solutions to improve project planning, reporting, operational efficiency, and overall delivery effectiveness.
Maintain accurate project documentation and artifacts within approved systems, including SharePoint as the source of truth.
Manage project financials, including budget tracking, forecasting, invoicing schedules, and financial reporting.
Identify and mitigate risks, issues, and dependencies while ensuring proper escalation and change control processes.
Produce high-quality status reports, executive updates, and project documentation for clients and leadership teams.
Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and contractual requirements.
Facilitate lessons learned sessions and retrospectives to support continuous improvement.
Effectively manage multiple concurrent projects within a fast-paced and evolving environment.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to support long-term partnerships and repeat business.

Qualifications

Required Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Learning & Development, Education, Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of project management experience managing end-to-end project delivery.
Experience working with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
Proven success managing client-facing projects in complex and fast-changing environments.
Experience managing project budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and schedules.

Skills & Capabilities

Strong project planning, organizational, and execution skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and client relationship-building abilities.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and project management tools.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled productivity tools to improve project outcomes.
Strong risk management, change management, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certification.
Experience within Learning & Development, Learning Experience (LX), Digital Learning, or Consulting environments.
Familiarity with instructional design, learning technologies, or learning transformation projects.

Why Join Us?

100% Remote position within Canada.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
Opportunity to work on impactful, innovative learning and transformation projects.
Collaborative and inclusive global team environment.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.

Interested? Apply today and help deliver exceptional learning experiences that make a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Ft. Lauderdale - Remote
jobs.description:
At SSR, we’re more than a leading engineering design, consulting, and planning firm—we’re a team of owners committed to solving complex projects and delivering innovative solutions for facility and infrastructure challenges. With locations across the U.S. and expertise spanning diverse markets and services, our collaborative approach empowers us to build lasting partnerships with each other, our clients, and our communities.

We believe high performance and a people-first culture go hand in hand. As an owner from day one, our colleagues thrive in an environment that values accountability, celebrates achievement, and supports personal and professional growth. As owners, we take pride in our work and in each other—driving results while fostering a workplace where everyone feels seen, supported, and inspired.

Want to hear directly from our team? Visit http://www.ssr-inc.com/life-at-ssr and explore our culture on LinkedIn and Instagram.

What You’ll Do

As a Project Manager II, you will hold overall responsibility for medium to high complexity projects or multiple concurrent projects—leading teams to achieve Total Project Success by meeting scope, schedule, budget, and quality goals. You will serve as the primary client contact, coordinate multi‑discipline resources and subconsultants, manage financial performance, and ensure projects are executed according to plan from kickoff through close‑out. Every colleague has a voice and a stake in our success through our ESOP, and we are driven by our mission to make a positive difference for our clients, colleagues, and communities.

Confirm project scope and requirements with clients and stakeholders; document assumptions and decisions.
Develop proposals and financial plans; prepare preliminary man‑hour budgets with CRM, Department Head, or Operations Director.
Ensure contracts are fully executed by the appropriate Principal and align the team to contractual obligations.
Lead effective project kick‑offs to convey scope, standards, budgets, roles, risks, and expectations.
Finalize discipline work plans and task‑hour budgets with design leads; update plans as conditions change.
Establish schedules with client input; set interim milestones for timely information flow and coordination.
Schedule and sequence work; communicate action items; monitor manpower plans across disciplines and maintain profit variance within targets.
Maintain complete project documentation and organized storage; keep logs current (RFI, submittal, decision, risk).
Facilitate meetings with owners, clients, architects, and contractors; document decisions and follow‑ups.
Track budgets, fee burn, and earned value; recognize how hours charged impact revenue and forecasts.
Identify, negotiate, and administer fees for additional services; process change orders promptly.
Prepare and implement proactive QA/QC plans; coordinate timely reviews and submittals to meet standards and contract requirements.
Manage Construction Administration to help ensure installed systems conform to design intent and quality standards.
Ensure accurate invoices are issued promptly; track AR status and update projected monthly revenue.
Resolve design and coordination issues by analyzing root causes and driving cross‑discipline solutions.
Supervise close‑out activities including punchlists, documentation, filings, lessons learned, and archive.
Build and grow client relationships through exceptional delivery; engage in business development with current and potential clients to expand services.

Minimum Requirements

Who We’re Looking For

Technical or Bachelor’s degree in one of the major technical disciplines practiced by the firm with eight years related project experience OR
Twelve years of practical experience on similar projects
Demonstrated, consistent ability to manage projects of various size and complexity
Professional Engineer Licensure preferred (required by those who have a ABET accredited degree in engineering)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading multi‑discipline design teams and coordinating subconsultants and contractors.
Command of project financials including pricing, fee burn, earned value, forecasts, and AR.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort with scheduling and resource planning tools.
Clear, concise communication and meeting facilitation; strong documentation and follow‑through.
Ability to analyze issues, evaluate trade‑offs, mitigate risk, and make sound decisions in collaboration with stakeholders.
Business development mindset with experience supporting proposals, interviews, and client workshops.

What We Offer

100% Employee-Owned – Ownership from day one with immediate ESOP vesting.
Retirement Savings – 401(k) with immediate vesting and a generous company match.
Health & Wellness – Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus company‑funded HSA contributions for HDHP plans.
Company-Paid Protection – Life insurance, AD&D, and short and long term disability at no cost to you.
Work-Life Balance – Flexible schedules, paid parental leave, generous PTO, and paid company holidays.
Career Growth – Tuition reimbursement and ongoing professional development support.

SSR is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer

EEO Disabled/Veterans

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

Recruiters or staffing agencies: SSR is not obligated to compensate any external recruiter or search firm who presents a candidate, their resume, or profile to an SSR employee without 1) a current, fully executed agreement on file and 2) being assigned to the open position via HR

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Nasze realne wyzwania i codzienność

Rozwijamy globalną platformę iGaming. Nasz produkt działa całodobowo na żywym organizmie, a zmiany na rynku zachodzą błyskawicznie. Działamy w rozproszonym zespole, stawiając na szybkie tempo wdrożeń i operacyjną elastyczność.

U nas dostajesz ogólny zarys nowej funkcji od biznesu, który samodzielnie planujesz i rozbijasz na konkretne kroki. Szukamy osoby, która weźmie operacyjną odpowiedzialność za projekty, sprawnie zepnie pracę różnych zespołów (Dev, UI/UX, SEO, Support) i zadba o to, by trafiały one na produkcję jako gotowy, działający produkt.

To rola z dużym wpływem na codzienny flow i przestrzenią na układanie procesów. Szukamy osoby skrupulatnej, która odciąży Product Ownera w operacyjnej pracy i dopilnuje terminów. Na co dzień skupisz się na przekładaniu wizji produktowej na szczegółowe taski (user stories, kryteria akceptacji) oraz technicznej weryfikacji bugów zgłaszanych przez support.

Twoja Codzienna Misja Zamknie Się w Trzech Obszarach

Spięcie zespołu i dowożenie produkcji
Łącznik między działami: Spinasz proces na linii Dev ➔ UI/UX ➔ SEO ➔ Support, żeby nikt na nikogo nie czekał.
Dbanie o płynność deploymentu: Prowadzisz statusy z programistami, pilnujesz terminów i dajesz zielone światło na wdrożenia.
Porządek w taskach: Dbasz o czysty backlog w Jira/Asana (zero wiszących, nieopisanych tematów).
Zewnętrzne integracje: Samodzielnie rozmawiasz z dostawcami i operatorami płatności - jak coś nie działa, męczysz ich support do skutku.
Triage, QA i trzymanie ręki na pulsie
Ostateczne QA: Przeklikujesz staging jako zwykły gracz. Ty podpisujesz się pod tym, że funkcja działa idealnie.
Niezawodność i wygląd platformy: Wyłapujesz info o awariach oraz pilnujesz z marketingiem, by wersje językowe i teksty na stronie wyglądały estetycznie.
Product Discovery & UX/UI (Wsparcie Product Ownera)
Przekładanie wizji na detale: Rozpisujesz ogólne założenia biznesowe na szczegółowe taski (user stories, kryteria akceptacji).
Figma i prototypy: Analizujesz user flow, współpracujesz z UX/UI Designerem i składasz szybkie prototypy No-Code przed napisaniem kodu.
User Research: Rozmawiasz z graczami (ankiety, wywiady) i wyciągasz ich realne potrzeby. Robimy to, czego chcą userzy, a nie to, co nam się wydaje fajne. Filtrujesz ich feedback, zanim trafi do PO.
Testy korytarzowe: Przed dużym wdrożeniem angażujesz team, żeby wyłapać nielogiczności w UX.
Asysta przy Roadmapie i Researchu: Robisz solidny research rynkowy i pomagasz PO układać roadmapę, przekładając zebrane wnioski i dane produktowe na konkretne rekomendacje.
Wpływ na produkt: Masz realny wpływ na to, jak działa funkcja. Nie tylko wykonujesz polecenia, ale aktywnie proponujesz ulepszenia w UI/UX i logice funkcji, żeby doświadczenie dawało graczom jak najwięcej frajdy.

Czego bezwzględnie oczekujemy? (Warunki konieczne)

Doświadczenia w samodzielnym rozpisywaniu zadań projektowych i technicznych w Jira / Asana na podstawie ogólnych założeń biznesowych.
Naturalnej, głębokiej zajawki na iGaming, e-sport i ekosystem CS2. Musisz czuć i rozumieć ten świat od środka: mechanikę giełd, trade locki, rynki P2P, skiny i kasyna CS-owe.
Odporności na presję czasu. Umiejętności porządkowania chaosu i szybkiego działania w dynamicznym środowisku .
Pełnej gotowości do nadgodzin i elastycznych godzin pracy. Jeśli odpowiadasz za żywy produkt, oczekujemy od Ciebie dyspozycyjności w niestandardowych godzinach (w tym również w weekendy), natychmiastowej reakcji i spięcia zespołu (zakładamy znaczną liczbę płatnych nadgodzin w miesiącu)
Doświadczenia w pracy w mniejszych strukturach (startupy, zwinne software house'y).
Praktycznej znajomości procesu triage: umiejętności wstępnej weryfikacji i replikacji bugów przed eskalowaniem ich wyżej do Product Ownera.
Umiejętności realnego wykorzystywania narzędzi AI (skuteczne promptowanie, automatyzacja pracy) w codziennych zadaniach.
Konkretności, asertywności i braku oporów przed prowadzeniem trudnych rozmów oraz egzekwowaniem ustaleń od doświadczonych specjalistów - stawianie na konkret, zamiast zastanawiać się, „czy wypada”.
Proaktywności, otwartości i łatwości w nawiązywaniu kontaktów. Poszukujemy osoby, która potrafi słuchać i sprawnie wyciągać od deweloperów potrzebne informacje.

Co oferujemy?

Wynagrodzenie: 8 500 - 10 500 zł netto na B2B (podstawa) / 6 500 - 8 500 zł brutto na UZ + DODATKOWO PŁATNE wszystkie nadgodziny.
2-miesięczny okres próbny, następnie umowa na czas nieokreślony.
Pracę w pełni zdalną.
Premie za wyniki i zaangażowanie. Doceniamy proaktywność - wysokie zaangażowanie i realne wyniki przekładają się bezpośrednio na Twój bonus finansowy.
Laptop MacBook.
Dofinansowanie do home office: zadbamy o to, abyś miał wygodne stanowisko pracy. Indywidualnie podchodzimy do potrzeb każdego pracownika, więc wspólnie wybierzemy akcesoria, które najlepiej będą odpowiadały Twoim potrzebom.
Budżet szkoleniowy: zależy nam na tym, abyś się rozwijał/a.
Możliwość udziału w konferencjach i wyjazdach służbowych - udział jest dobrowolny, a firma pokrywa koszty.
Kultura organizacyjna: jesteśmy innowacyjną i dynamiczną firmą, w której Twój rozwój nie napotyka żadnych ograniczeń, to Ty decydujesz, jak daleko chcesz zajść.
Przerwa w świadczeniu usług (20 dni) oraz dni ustawowo wolne od pracy.
Mamy stały rytm dnia, natomiast nie ma problemu, abyś w trakcie zrobił/a sobie dłuższą przerwę na trening, lekarza lub inne zobowiązania.
Multisport.
Kompleksowe wsparcie psychologiczne dostępne dla każdego pracownika, Twoje zdrowie i dobrostan są dla nas priorytetem.
Program poleceń pracowników.
Otwartość na Twoje pomysły: jeśli brakuje Ci jakiegoś benefitu, jesteśmy gotowi go rozważyć.

Proces rekrutacji

Analiza CV – sprawdzimy Twoje doświadczenie oraz naturalną zajawkę na iGaming.
Case study – krótkie zadanie rekrutacyjne, w którym zweryfikujemy Twój sposób działania i reakcję na kryzysy.
Spotkanie HR (30 min) - skupimy się na Twoim podejściu do zarządzania projektami oraz Twojej motywacji do działania.
Spotkanie rekrutacyjne (30 min) - porozmawiamy o Twoich skillach, elastyczności i realiach projektu.
Finalna decyzja i witamy na pokładzie! 🚀

Brzmi jak wyzwanie dla Ciebie? Jeśli potrafisz układać procesy w dynamicznym środowisku i chcesz wziąć realną odpowiedzialność za produkt - dołącz do nas!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Castor, we’re modernizing the backbone of clinical research

Clinical trials are the gatekeepers of human health, yet the industry is still bogged down by fragmented, manual processes that can waste time and exclude patient populations. At Castor, we are building the operating system for the next era of clinical research.

We provide a modular cloud platform designed to run trials end-to-end. Our foundation is a robust Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system, supported by eConsent for recruitment and screening and eCOA to accurately capture patient reported outcomes. We don’t just stop at data collection; we use Castor Catalyst (our high-precision AI automation) to strip away the manual effort that historically makes research slow and expensive.

How we work: Trust over tracking

We are a remote-first company built on the belief that talented people do their best work when they have the agency to manage their own lives. We believe that high performance requires a foundation of trust, health, and cutting-edge support.

Work-life integration: We don't believe in performative presence. We trust you to own your schedule and show up for your team, while also making space for your life outside of work.
Deep work & async: We protect your time. We prioritize thoughtful, asynchronous communication so you can focus on solving hard problems without a calendar full of status update meetings.
Radical candor: We value the truth over hierarchy. We give and receive direct feedback because that’s how we grow—as individuals and as a company.

Your mission and impact

As a Senior Project Manager
you will lead our most complex, multi-component, multi-country studies, serving as a subject matter expert. Your value to the projects lies in your critical thinking and ability to translate high-level, often vague project scope into robust and operationally sound project plans & deliverables.

This is not traditional task-tracking, but high-autonomy and consultative on specialised or new services. You will navigate the increased variables and technical and operational dependencies that come with complex studies, operating with minimal oversight. Please note that this is a strategic position focused on project delivery and does not include direct people management.
You will act as the pivotal bridge and consultant to the customer, taking ownership of the end-to-end delivery from ensuring internal project cohesion to leveraging your risk expertise to confidently articulate challenges and guide external stakeholders to the best possible solution.

Who are you

You are energized by first of their kind studies
You naturally shift from simple process following to active solution leading, applying deep critical thinking to every challenge
You remain focused and effective when faced with shifting priorities, rapid change, or undefined project parameters
You act as a high-level consultant to clients, building trust through advocacy and persuasive communication.
You proactively navigate risk, identifying downstream impacts early and architecting solutions that safeguard project integrity.
You are a self-starter who masters the art of remote collaboration. You value deep work and asynchronous communication to drive results
Giving and receiving feedback are necessary to win as a team. You give and receive direct, data-driven feedback, even when it’s uncomfortable

What you’ll bring

Proven expertise in managing highly complex projects within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for clinical software
Strong understanding of EDC/CDMS, eConsent and eCOA solutions, services and operational strategies
Experience with eCOA services scale licensing, translations, device provisioning, Helpdesk and data management
Strong experience of using project tools such as Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Project (or equivalent)
Deep understanding of the regulatory landscape and industry trends to guide project strategy
Comprehensive knowledge of clinical study operations, ensuring technical solutions align with site workflows, patient centricity, and study-specific operational requirements
Direct experience or foundational understanding of Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies, including the unique data capture and longitudinal tracking needs of late-phase research

Accepting candidates +2/-2 CET. At this time, we cannot accept applications from France, Germany, Spain, or Switzerland.

How we invest in you

High performance isn't sustainable without real support. We provide the infrastructure you need to stay healthy, focused, and rewarded.
Rest is non-negotiable: Unlimited annual leave with 25-day minimum. We don’t just allow time off; we expect you to take it.
Downtime weeks: Once a quarter, the whole company shifts gears. No new shipping—just a week for deep focus, learning, or catching up so we can start the next quarter fresh.
AI-first culture: We provide the tools and training to ensure you’re spending your energy on high-value work, not manual repetition.
Real ownership: All Castor team members are offered options through our Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).
Comprehensive wellbeing: Free access to Open Up for mental health, specialized sleep courses (for you and your family), and a budget to make your home office a place you actually want to be.
Annual bonus: A guaranteed "Happy Holidays" bonus every December.

Compensation at Castor

Castor is a remote, globally distributed company, and as such we use location based salary bands. We believe compensation should be fair and transparent, without unnecessary complexity. For us, compensation means salary + equity + benefits, all of which are designed to support you in doing your best work, wherever you are.
This position is open to candidates across multiple regions. Before your interview is scheduled we will share the corresponding regional band for your specific country.

Belonging at Castor

We build products to make research accessible to everyone, and we believe our team should reflect that same diversity.
Our remote setup is designed to support you as a whole person—your family, your mental health, and your authentic self.
We don't care about your background as much as we care about your perspective and your expertise. We strongly encourage applications from women, people of color, and the LGBTQ+ community. Please feel free to share the pronouns you use (for example she/her/hers, he/her/his, they/them/theirs, etc.).

jobs.description:
Title:
Project Manager
Company:
WEM Automation (Valstone Portfolio)
Location:
In person - W237N2920 Woodgate Road, Suite 100, Pewaukee, WI 53072, US

About WEM Automation

WEM Automation LLC is the leading supplier of control systems for the feed and grain, aggregate, concrete, and asphalt industries. Founded in Milwaukee in 1955, WEM has spent over 70 years delivering trusted process automation systems across North America — constantly evolving its capabilities to capture tangible value for customers.

WEM's purpose is simple: unlock tangible value for the animal feed and aggregates industries through automation and analytics. Our success is built not only on engineering excellence but on the strength of our customer relationships and our ability to execute complex projects with precision.

WEM Automation is a Valstone company. Valstone is an industrial software conglomerate that acquires and operates mission-critical software businesses across agriculture, logistics, food processing, bulk materials, and manufacturing — taking a long-term, buy-and-hold approach to building businesses.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager who thrives at the intersection of structure and people—organized, clear, and steady, even when the stakes are high and the details are complex. This is a client-facing role built around building real relationships, creating clarity, and driving progress across cross-functional teams. We're looking for someone who can read between the lines—understanding not just what's being asked, but what actually matters—and who brings a relationship-first, strategic mindset to every project. If you love keeping things on track, influencing without direct authority, and solving problems before they become fire drills, you'll thrive here. This role also includes regular travel to customer sites.

What You Bring

Mindset Over Tenure

—
Naturally organized and detail-oriented—you get energy from creating structure where there is none.
—
Calm under pressure—you don't panic, you plan.
—
Curious and collaborative—you ask good questions and know how to work with people who think differently than you.
—
Comfortable saying what needs to be said—even when it's hard.
—
A natural relationship-builder—people trust you quickly, and you know how to read a room.
—
Strategic—you can see past the immediate ask to what's truly important, and prioritize accordingly.

Experience & Skills

—
Small business experience with direct, hands-on customer interaction—not a large corporate PM structure where customer contact is layered or indirect.
—
Manufacturing and/or software industry background preferred.
—
Business analyst experience—translating customer needs into technical requirements—is a strong bonus.
—
Comfort working with budgets, timelines, and tradeoffs—you understand the business impact of decisions.
—
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
—
Familiarity with project management tools, Gantt charts, and milestone tracking.
—
Comfortable developing and presenting customer quotations, and translating requirements into scope and pricing.
—
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to customer sites.

Education

—
Bachelor's degree preferred — what matters most is how you think and lead.
—
PMP, CAPM, or CSM certification a bonus.

What You'll Do

Be the Bridge Between Teams and Customers

—
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer projects, ensuring scope is defined, expectations are aligned, and progress is transparent.
—
Understand what a customer actually needs and translate it into clear, actionable requirements our engineers can build against—thinking like a business analyst as much as a project manager.
—
Translate technical plans and internal priorities into clear action items and timelines.
—
Keep both internal teams and customers focused, informed, and aligned.

Navigate Complexity With Clarity and Control

—
Track milestones, dependencies, and risks with obsessive clarity.
—
Proactively address blockers and resolve issues before they escalate.
—
Bring structure and momentum to each phase of the project lifecycle—from kickoff through commissioning.

Work Cross-Functionally to Get Things Done

—
Coordinate across engineering, service, sales, and manufacturing teams to ensure seamless execution.
—
Influence outcomes through credibility, clarity, and consistency—not just authority.
—
Adapt communication style based on audience—plant operators, software engineers, executives.

Manage the Narrative

—
Own customer communications around project progress, changes, and timelines.
—
Anticipate concerns, manage expectations, and build trust by delivering what we say we will—on time and on spec.
—
Document key decisions, surface tradeoffs, and ensure alignment at each stage.

Optimize Schedule Across Customer Projects

—
Align production and resource planning with forecasted customer targets and project needs.
—
Coordinate with engineering and service teams to ensure delivery timelines are achievable, adjusting proactively as demand shifts.
—
Use available data to recommend scheduling strategies that balance efficiency, quality, and delivery timelines.

Develop Customer Quotations

—
Partner with sales and engineering to develop and prepare customer-requested quotations.
—
Translate customer requirements into clear, accurate scope and pricing.
—
Balance responsiveness to customer requests with the realities of scheduling, resourcing, and delivery.

Why WEM? Why Now?

WEM is in the midst of an exciting transformation—modernizing how we serve our customers while preserving the trust we've earned over decades. As Project Manager, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring that our systems are delivered with the same integrity, clarity, and excellence that define our brand.

If you're ready to step into a role where your structure, presence, and people sense can truly make a difference—let's talk.

About The Job

Position Overview:

The Office of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (GPS Office) is a core unit in the Medical School and serves to oversee and support the training of graduate students and postdoctoral trainees. The GPS Office develops and manages programs aimed at enhancing recruitment, retention, research training, and career development for graduate students and postdoctoral trainees. The Program Manager will be assigned primarily to focus on postdoctoral trainee programs, but will also collaborate with and provide assistance to other GPS Office team members including assisting with graduate student programming.

The Position Reports To The Associate Director Of The GPS Office And Works Closely With a Number Of Internal Stakeholders Including The Medical School Office Of The Dean, Office Of Research, And The Office Of Diversity Equity And Inclusion. Other Internal Stakeholders Specific To The Programs Include

Graduate Student Programs: Directors of Graduate Programs (DGS), Council of Graduate Students (CGS) in the Medical School, and Graduate Program Coordinators (GPC).

Postdoctoral Trainee Programs: UMN Postdoctoral Association, Graduate School Office of Postdoctoral Initiatives, and Medical School Postdoctoral Council. 

The Medical School is committed to an excellent employee experience, offering a flexible work environment that meets the needs of students, staff, faculty, and the communities we serve. Flexible work arrangements may include flexibility in schedule and/or work location. All UMN employees are expected to follow applicable public health and safety procedures. This position is hybrid with an expectation of two days on campus; additional days on campus may be needed depending on programming responsibilities.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

The position works to design, develop, implement and manage program initiatives and activities for graduate students, and postdoctoral trainees to:
Increase the number, quality and diversity of graduate students and postdoctoral trainees applying to and being accepted into graduate and biomedical research programs in the Medical School through the development of and travel to targeted recruitment initiatives and outreach efforts.
To support and create initiatives and programming elements to enhance advanced research education, research training outcomes and career development.
Assist the Associate Director of the GPS Office in executing strategic plans for structured academic support activities to enhance the training quality and activities for graduate students and postdoctoral trainees.
Develop and implement tools and processes for performance tracking, analytics and quantitative/qualitative measurements to evaluate success outcomes and training environments for key programs.
Assist programs in generating data of key metrics, outcomes and productivity for intramural and extramural funded programs.

Primary Responsibilities

Primary responsibilities are listed below. Note that incumbent will be primarily assigned to Postdoctoral Studies Programs, with an expectation for collaboration and coverage across the GPS

Office Responsibilities

Postdoctoral Trainee Programs

40%: Design and manage outreach and recruiting initiatives for prospective trainees in biomedical research for the Medical School

In collaboration with the Program Manager for Graduate Studies, develop program recruitment initiatives and outreach approaches to bolster the recruitment of top-tier prospective trainees to research laboratories across the Medical School, with a chief focus on increasing the number of women and trainees from underrepresented groups. This includes identifying and employing best practices for outreach, developing recruiting content, establishing and building relationships with institutional partners, identification of and travel to recruitment fairs and webinars, among other activities.
Manage communication plans to drive prospective postdoctoral trainee awareness of and interaction with Medical School Centers, Institutes, and Departments to result in increased application submissions.
Collaborate with various Medical School Offices and Departments to recruit top-tier postdoctoral trainees for research positions using various online tools, databases and social platforms.
Maintain an internal postdoctoral trainee application database that Departments, Faculty Members and Administrative Units can utilize to post available positions for mentor identification and postdoctoral trainee placements.

45%: Create and support programming elements and initiatives to enhance retention, research education, and career development training outcomes for current postdoctoral trainees in the

Medical School

In collaboration with the Program Manager for Graduate Studies, develop and implement seminars and workshops to enhance career development and postdoctoral training outcomes, which include, but not limited to: CV development and resume building seminars, networking opportunities, and career exploration services.
Develop and implement seminars and workshops to enhance research education, which include, but not limited to: scientific writing and grantsmanship, grant application submission, and laboratory management.
Serve as a resource for postdoctoral trainees and assist in matters related to onboarding, orientation, financial assistance (i.e. fellowships, grants), health benefits, and other postdoctoral trainee support resources.
Implement program activities in conjunction with Medical School Basic Science Departments to foster networking and research education opportunities for current postdoctoral trainees.
Establish relationships with key administrative units for continual dialogue on how to provide best practices and support for postdoctoral training activities.
Advise and direct administrative support to assist the Medical School Postdoctoral Council in consultation with the Medical School Administrators and Associate Director of the GPS Office.
Additionally, serve as a liaison to or a representative for committees and working groups focused on postdoctoral trainee initiatives and enhanced training outcomes.

15%: Effort - Develop and implement performance tracking, analytics and quantitative and qualitative measurements for evaluating student outcomes and research education environments.

Develop and evaluate information technology methods to provide the following: trainee recruitment and entry outcomes, performance metrics (i.e. fellowships, publications, honors and awards), departure dates, and career progression of former trainees.
Define and employ information technology for record keeping, data analytics, survey/evaluative assessments and performance tracking of trainees.
Oversee and implement key analytics and data reporting to support individual Department and Administrative units for extramural research funding efforts.
Manage the data acquisition and analytics to provide key metrics for T32 grant PIs and document diversity recruiting plans for new or renewing proposals.
Develop and implement a survey administered to postdoctoral trainees, faculty and staff to gauge current research climate, measurable diversity goals achieved, trainee wellness and other analytical metrics important for enhancing the research education climate. Utilize these surveys to determine barriers to trainee retention by assessing research education culture and climate, as well as identifying and employing best practices for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Assess visibility of existing Department and Administration Units website (WebSEO software). Analyze traffic to postdoctoral training program websites (Google Analytics). Make recommendations to individual Departments and Administrative Units to bolster trainee engagement and retention.
Create methods to assess the effectiveness of the complex constellation of activities, diverse research climates, and changing/evolving base to pivot as necessary in modification of best practices to compete for the most talented postdoctoral trainees.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

BS degree in the biomedical sciences or public health-related fields
Minimum of 6 years of relevant work experience in program management OR Master's degree plus at least four years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications

MS or EdD/PhD degree in higher education, leadership, biomedical sciences or education policy & analysis
Familiarity with Smartsheet, Qualtrics and Tableau
Understanding of biomedical graduate training and NIH guidelines
Experience in a higher education environment involving students and administration
Experience in leading workshops for graduate students or postdoctoral trainees
Understanding of leadership principles either through application or training
Experience collecting survey and outcome data and gaining stakeholder input

About The Department

Committed to innovation and diversity, the Medical School educates physicians, scientists, and health professionals; generates knowledge and treatments; and cares for patients and communities with compassion and respect. We value excellence, inclusiveness, collaboration, and discovery.

The mission of the regional campus located in Duluth is to be a national leader in improving healthcare access and outcomes in rural Minnesota and American Indian/Alaska Native (AI/AN) communities. In partnership with CentraCare, the regional campus in St. Cloud offers a wide range of patient experiences throughout students’ education in Greater Minnesota and prepares them to become exceptional clinicians and leaders for rural and immigrant populations.

Founded in 1888, the University of Minnesota Medical School has three campuses. A four-year MD program and the MD/PhD program are located on the Twin Cities campus in addition to MD programs at regional campuses in Duluth and St. Cloud.

Pay And Benefits

Pay Range:
$68,000-$72,000 annually ; depending on education/qualifications/experience

Time Appointment:
100% Appointment

Work Location:
Hybrid

Position Type:
Faculty and P&A Staff

Please visit the Office of Human Resources website for more information regarding benefit eligibility.

The University Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package That Includes

Competitive wages, paid holidays, and generous time off
Continuous learning opportunities through professional training and degree-seeking programs supported by the Regents Tuition Benefit Program
Low-cost medical, dental, and pharmacy plans
Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts
University HSA contributions
Disability and employer-paid life insurance
Employee wellbeing program
Excellent retirement plans with employer contribution
Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) opportunity
Financial counseling services
Employee Assistance Program with eight sessions of counseling at no cost
Employee Transit Pass with free or reduced rates in the Twin Cities metro area

While our salary ranges provide a framework, it is important to note that most of the

time, the initial pay may not reach the maximum of the range. This approach ensures

that compensation reflects the value and unique contributions of each candidate while

maintaining equity within our organization. As part of our commitment to fair and

equitable compensation, please be aware that the salary offered to incoming candidates

will be based on their individual credentials and experience.

How To Apply

Applications must be submitted online. To be considered for this position, please click the Apply button and follow the instructions. You will have the opportunity to complete an online application for the position and attach a cover letter and resume or CV.

This position will remain open until filled.

To request an accommodation during the application process, please e-mail jobcentr@umn.edu.

jobs.description:
Req Id:
432514

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

The Senior Technical Program Manager is responsible for establishing, coordinating, and governing the integrated readiness programs required to bring Bell's AI Fabric data centres from construction into production operations.

This role serves as the central program integration function across Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Network Architecture, Vendor Management, Health & Safety, Human Resources, ServiceNow, Asset Management, and Site Operations teams. The successful candidate will develop integrated readiness plans, track critical milestones, manage cross-functional dependencies, and provide executive visibility to ensure all operational, staffing, safety, technology, and vendor readiness requirements are completed prior to facility go-live.

The role is focused on program governance, readiness planning, risk management, and execution oversight, ensuring Bell AI Fabric facilities are prepared for Day 1 operations through disciplined program management and stakeholder coordination.

Key Responsibilities

Program Management & Readiness Governance

Develop and maintain integrated readiness plans across multiple AI Fabric projects and sites.
Establish program governance structures, readiness criteria, stage gates, and acceptance milestones.
Coordinate readiness activities across all participating business units and delivery teams.
Track completion of readiness deliverables and ensure accountability for assigned workstreams.
Monitor critical-path activities and manage cross-functional dependencies.
Identify and escalate risks, issues, and schedule impacts affecting operational readiness.
Lead readiness reviews, governance forums, and executive steering committees.
Provide consolidated executive reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and status updates.

Operational Readiness Program Leadership

Establish operational readiness frameworks supporting commissioning-to-operations transition activities.
Coordinate readiness requirements for site turnover and operational acceptance.
Ensure readiness plans address staffing, training, processes, vendor support, systems, tools, documentation, and governance requirements.
Validate completion of readiness activities prior to customer onboarding and production operations.
Track and report readiness status against agreed milestones and go-live criteria.

Workforce & Organizational Readiness

Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to coordinate workforce readiness plans.
Track recruiting, onboarding, training, certification, and competency milestones required for site startup.
Coordinate organizational readiness activities across operational, technical, vendor management, network operations, and support teams.
Monitor workforce readiness progress and escalate gaps that may impact go-live objectives.

Vendor & Service Readiness

Coordinate readiness plans involving OEMs, maintenance providers, strategic vendors, and service partners.
Track completion of service agreements, support contracts, escalation processes, and spare parts strategies.
Collaborate with Procurement and Vendor Management teams to ensure operational support models are established prior to site launch.
Monitor vendor readiness milestones and report status to leadership teams.

Technology & ServiceNow Readiness

Coordinate readiness activities supporting ServiceNow, Asset Management, CMMS, and operational support platforms.
Track implementation milestones associated with asset onboarding, maintenance programs, work management processes, inventory management, and operational reporting.
Ensure operational technology platforms meet readiness requirements before operational handover.
Facilitate alignment between business stakeholders and platform delivery teams.

Network & Technology Integration Readiness

Coordinate with Network Architecture and Technology Operations teams to monitor readiness activities supporting site activation.
Track network commissioning, carrier delivery, monitoring integration, and operational support requirements.
Ensure dependencies related to DCIM, EPMS, monitoring, alarming, and operational tooling are incorporated into readiness plans.
Coordinate customer technology onboarding readiness requirements and associated milestones.

Critical Accountabilities

The Senior Technical Program Manager is accountable for:

Development and maintenance of integrated readiness programs
Program governance and executive reporting
Readiness milestone tracking and delivery oversight
Cross-functional dependency management
Risk identification, mitigation tracking, and escalation
Operational acceptance and go-live readiness coordination
Workforce readiness tracking
Vendor readiness oversight
ServiceNow and operational systems readiness coordination
Executive stakeholder engagement and communication

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

jobs.title: Program Manager (R&D)
jobs.description:
Grow With Us

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

Stay Awesome

Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A Day In The Life

The Program Manager (PM) leads cross-functional core teams and manages complex software projects and/or system-level programs through Tandem’s product development process, with the main goal of developing and delivering new medical device products to market. The Program Manager is expected to exemplify the program management function and capabilities within Tandem and external partners. Key elements of the function include: execution in a phase gate process that defines development team deliverables throughout the product life cycle, lead/participate in core and scrum meetings, establish and drive the team’s project plan and schedule with clearly defined core team roles and responsibilities, establish project metrics, execute PM responsibilities as defined by our Design Control procedures. The Program Manager is also expected to lead or participate in process improvement initiatives led by the PMO.

Program Manager's At Tandem Are Also Responsible for:

Provides project management expertise and leadership to a multi-functional core team from Concept through Commercialization following Tandem’s standard process for product development and/or Design change; ensures implementation and compliance to Design Control procedures and improvements of systems, procedures, and documentation.
Plans and directs all aspects of software/systems projects/programs. Establishes project plans and objectives, develops project cost analysis, establishes, and manages the project schedule and budget, manages resources, tracks progress, and provides updates to management and external partners. Works closely with the Program Office, Project Managers, and functional heads to resolve resource allocation issues, conflicts, and priorities and to ensure projects are staffed appropriately, completed on time, and within budget constraints. Ensures efficient transfer of product from R&D to manufacturing and external marketing.
Leads/participates in process improvement initiatives related to product development, resource management and allocation, design controls, and other areas that impact cycle time, efficiencies, and compliance in medical device product development.
Communicates and presents regular and timely project status updates to various levels of the organization including the executive management team and external partners.
As necessary, performs other duties as required to support the PMO.

When & Where You’ll Work

Hybrid: This role will be a mix of in-office work at our corporate headquarters in Del Mar, CA and remote work. This position is expected to be in office 2-3 days per week but may vary depending on business demands.

What You’ll Need

Demonstrated success working in complex matrixed organizations and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
Proven ability to drive cultural change and implement project management best practices.
Strong communication and executive-level influencing skills to manage scope, resources, and priorities.
Skilled at leading, motivating, and aligning project teams to meet schedule and business objectives.
Proficient with project management tools for planning, scheduling, task management, resource allocation, and collaboration.
Advanced Microsoft Office expertise, including Excel (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards/graphs), PowerPoint, and MS Project.
Experience with Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), documentation, and review processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build strong internal and external partnerships.
Strong organizational, prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities while maintaining confidentiality.
Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, product development processes, engineering principles, and medical device industry practices.

Extra Awesome

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field; or a combination of education and applicable experience.
Certificate in Project Management (PMP) is desired. Alternatively, should be willing to pursue professional certification in the future.
Scrum Certification a plus.
4 years’ directly related experience in managing projects in FDA-regulated and ISO 14971 certified industry.
4 years’ experience in the medical device industry and compliance to internal Quality Systems.
Experience in managing projects from inception to post-market sustaining using a phase-gate methodology.
Experience in managing projects focused on solutions for people with diabetes a plus.
Knowledge and experience in the implementation of regulatory requirements for medical device development such as FDA’s Design Controls, ISO’s Risk Management and Medical Device standards, ISO Software Development standards (e.g., IEC 62304).

Compensation & Benefits

The starting base pay range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000
annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.
Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

You Should Know

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.
Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

Sponsorship

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.
Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers.

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.
Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

Referrals

We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

Application Deadline

The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.
Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

Join a pioneering team dedicated to transforming the way people use Alexa in the kitchen. The Alexa Food team owns Alexa recipe curation, cooking library management, and personalization of each customer's unique tastes and restrictions. As we continue to execute on our Alexa+ vision for Food, we are seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of Food for our customers.

As a member of our innovative team, you will play a pivotal role in crafting immersive Food experiences across various devices and endpoints. We have a number of new experiences we're building in 2026 and your contributions will directly impact millions of users worldwide in executing your charter.

You will get the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art LLM and GenerativeAI models in this role as you create delightful experiences.

Define and deliver critical program for Alexa+
Establish mechanisms necessary for delivery and management
Influence and drive technical decisions
Assess and mitigate risks, handle escalations, and provide concise and transparent updates to stakeholders at all levels
Dive deep to understand complex problems and break them down into small pieces with straight forward solutions
Mentor individuals in the community on advanced technical issues, and help them grow their careers
Working with a fantastic development team based in Chennai (IST)

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

This role falls under the Technical Program Management domain. You will be a Lead Technical Program Manager
, responsible for driving a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, while simultaneously designing and deploying AI-enabled tooling to eliminate organizational toil. This role moves beyond traditional program management, requiring both strategic leadership
and foundational engineering skills
to build robust, scalable, and impactful solutions.

You will be at the forefront of the TPM Cyborganization
vision, ensuring the function evolves into one optimised for strategic leadership, influence, and AI-augmented execution.

You will report to the Head of Technical Programme Management, will be based on fully on-site in Cluj-Napoca.

Strategic Program Leadership: Focus on driving strategic initiatives, complex cross-functional programs, and org-wide change management. You will apply a high proportion of effort to high-value, strategic activities. This will take up to 20% of your daily focus.
AI-Enabled Workflow Replacement: Identify, define, and execute on automating high-impact toil. This involves design, develop, and deploy AI-tools and agents that uses LLM to automate program execution toil work.
Tool Building & Deployment:
Design, develop, and deploy AI-tools and agents that automate program execution toil work.
One of your formal performance goals will be "AI-enabled workflow replacement".
This must include building a tool that uses LLMs as part of its core functionality.

Engineering Practice: Apply foundational engineering skills and structured software development practices to create robust and scalable internal tooling. This includes:
Applying best practices for API and architecture design.
Utilizing version control (Git) and participating in code review practices.
Familiarity with deployment pipelines, CI/CD, and production considerations.

Stakeholder & Team Engagement: Accelerate impact, build high-performing teams, and drive effective prioritization. You will work with cross-functional teams and leadership stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly..

Qualifications

At least 8 years experiences in a role focused on strategic initiatives and cross-functional technical program management.
Combine strategic infrastructure development with tactical execution to build scalable processes while achieving immediate operational milestones.
A proven track record of delivering projects by aligning leadership and driving cross-functional execution.
Foundational understanding of software engineering and development practices (e.g., system architecture, clean code principles, deployment).
Experience with AI/automation tooling and the ability to apply these skills to eliminate repetitive toil.
Prior experiences on building automation on n8n and Cursor is an added value.
Excel in high-growth environments, applying autonomy to pivot strategies.

Life at Grab

ATI's standard business hours are Monday-Friday, between 8 AM - 5 PM.

ATI builds and manages collaborations that conducts research and development of new technologies to solve our nation’s most pressing challenges. Our collaborations are custom-built teams of organizations from industry and academia that develop novel technologies for the federal government. Traditionally, these processes are complicated and burdensome. That’s where ATI comes in. We simplify and streamline processes to make it all work. When you work at ATI, you become a part of something larger than yourself. Our collective work – no matter what department or division you work in – ultimately enables the warfighter, saves lives, and diversifies the industrial base. At our core, ATI is a service organization. We are in service to others; it’s what we do, and it’s who we are.

Apply at ATI.ORG; we only accept applications submitted through our applicant tracking system.

We offer a hybrid schedule (in-office & remote/work from home) or an onsite schedule and flexible hours. Candidates will need to reside near Charleston, SC to ensure work site flexibility.

Position Description

The Program Manager is responsible for managing a portfolio of projects and supporting program operations for ATI’s submarine and shipbuilding industrial base portfolio and related defense industrial base efforts. This role plans, organizes, directs, and controls program and project activities to accomplish sponsor and business goals within cost, schedule, and performance requirements. The Program Manager exercises discretion and independent judgment with respect to matters of significance to the business and typically operates with a high degree of autonomy.

Essential Functions:

Manages a portfolio of projects across various stages of development and execution, including project startup, award, execution oversight, issue resolution, reporting, and closeout.
Oversees project and program planning activities, including scope refinement, statements of work, proposals, deliverables, baseline development, kickoff coordination, new-start activities, and actions needed to improve project agreement or procurement lead times.
Ensures compliance with program and project contracts, agreements, deliverables, schedules, budgets, and reporting requirements, and oversees project controls related to scope, cost, schedule, risk, and performance, including some form of Earned Value Management, as required by the program.
Works with finance and project teams to understand program-level financial status, support budget planning, review and approve financial and project documentation, and facilitate resolution of cost, schedule, contractual, technical, and execution issues across the assigned portfolio.
Supervises and provides direction to project managers and other assigned staff, including workload balancing, development planning, coaching, and day-to-day operational support.
Coordinates with technical staff, contracts, finance, communications, and leadership to ensure integrated program execution and effective communication across internal and external stakeholders.
Leads recurring program meetings, portfolio reviews, customer engagements, project review sessions, program briefings, technical transfer events, customer reports, presentations, white papers, and related communications.
Serves as a technical representative on pertinent projects, as needed, and ensures effective interface with Government stakeholders, prime contractors, shipbuilders, suppliers, academic performers, and lower-tier subcontractors.
Guides and reviews team efforts related to technology implementation within shipyard and supplier environments, including establishment of appropriate Go/No-Go metrics, producibility targets, validation plans, and other implementation criteria.
Coordinates and manages cross-functional technical interchanges to support technology insertion, process improvement, and transition activities across the portfolio.
Provides oversight and direction for team integration of technology such as intelligent factory systems, digital manufacturing capabilities, and analytics, including AI/ML-enabled production analytics, where applicable, to support improvements in schedule adherence, quality, and labor or material utilization.
Contributes to program-level management functions such as process control, standard operating procedures, administrator workload planning, training, marketing support materials, or operational documentation.

Additional Responsibilities:

Interacts daily with Technical Director, division leadership, contracts personnel, financial personnel, technical personnel, and ATI management.
Supports identification and pursuit of related business development opportunities and contributes to proposal development.
Assists with customer engagement and strategic planning activities.
Backfills senior leadership functions, as appropriate, in meetings and internal coordination activities.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree and five or more related years of experience or equivalent combination of experience and training, or a master’s degree and three or more related years of experience or equivalent combination of experience and training. A degree in Engineering, Science, Supply Chain, Technical Program Management, or a related field is preferred.

Project and/or process management experience is required. PMP certification is viewed favorably but is not required. Experience with government programs is viewed favorably but is not required.

Strong communication skills, including presentations, technical reports, meeting management, and group management, are required. Strong computer skills, including intermediate Excel skills and proficiency in MS Office Suite—Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Project—are desired. MS Access experience is a plus.

Prior experience supervising project managers or coordinating team workload across multiple projects is desirable.

Specific Skillsets of Interest

ATI anticipates filling multiple positions to strengthen our team. We seek strong technical managers first and foremost; experience in one or more of these following disciplines is a valuable bonus.

Experience includes shipbuilding, submarine industrial base programs, manufacturing technology development, technology implementation, supplier development, workforce development, technical training, industrial base investment, strategic outsourcing, or supply chain management. Experience supporting Other Transaction Authority/Other Transaction Agreement projects, prototype efforts, or other alternative acquisition environments is viewed favorably.

Additional desirable technical experience includes one or more of the following domains: robotics and automated manufacturing systems; additive manufacturing; materials and processes, including composites, metals, and ceramics; design and structural analysis; digital manufacturing ecosystems, including digital twin and digital thread; AI/ML; modeling and simulation; welding engineering; systems engineering; and inspection technologies or nondestructive testing methods such as ultrasonic inspection and digital radiography, particularly in naval manufacturing environments.

Highly desirable experience also includes implementing design or process changes in production or shipyard settings and coordinating technology implementation activities. Experience collaborating with Navy program offices, major shipbuilders, OEMs, and multi-organizational project teams is similarly valued.

Must be either a U.S. Citizen by birth or naturalization.

Must successfully pass a background to access sensitive information and automated systems.

$110,000 - $120,000

jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Job Description

Be part of a great team and play a prominent leadership role in our mission to protect our customers' facilities, personnel, and operations! Our leaders are driven by performance excellence, personal integrity, and a commitment to the security mission.

Vaxcom Services LLC (a Parsons company) is looking for an experienced Security Cluster Manager to join our team! In this role you will get to provide oversight, direction, and hands on leadership/management to several sensitive sites located in the northern VA area.

What You'll Be Doing

Leading a large security team in a data center secure/classified environment according to Customer's expectations and Statement of Work/Work Order and by overseeing the execution of the program management plan and Statement of Work/Work Order.
- Specifically, you and your team will:
Control access to the facility/site by monitoring surveillance equipment, while ensuring all personnel entering the site have the proper credentials.
Maintain or oversee maintenance of weekly operating schedules and provide after-hours emergency response as required.
Oversee response to incidents of fire, medical emergency, bomb threat, elevator emergency, hazardous materials, inclement weather, and other incidents that may occur during the day or night.
Meet or exceed cost-saving/efficiency & operational goals while providing exceptional customer service.
Provide technical guidance and oversight to subordinates within the work groups spread across several facilities/sites.
Monitor productivity and proficiency to ensure that completed assignments meet the Customer’s required quality standards, budgets, and procedures. This may include disciplining or terminating personnel when appropriate.
Participate in interview and selection processes as needed.
Maintain clear and concise work standards and goals, and provide training and development utilizing coaching and counseling. This may include performance reviews and recognition processes.
Ensure that assigned personnel are thoroughly trained in and observe all safety measures related to their work area according to Customer requirements.
Assume regular Security Officer roles and responsibilities when appropriate.
Facilitate communication and act as point of contact for security matters at several location/sites, responsible for coordinating communication between on-site security personnel, program management office (PMO) and Customer while ensuring compliance with security protocols, by actively monitoring site conditions, identifying potential risks, and facilitating timely responses to security incidents.

Develop/maintain operational procedures so that valid location/site-specific operations and Post Orders are always available for emergency reference by vendor personnel.
Oversee the tracking of broken device repairs; manage a Remedy Tracking System ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Tracking alarm violations and managing/completing the reporting to the Customer.
Oversee the management of uniforms, equipment, supplies, and vehicles utilized at all facilities/sites.
Travel between facilities/sites as needed including for meetings outside of the Cluster.
Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

What Required Skills You'll Bring

Must have an active and current TS/SCI with Polygraph at the time of application.
College/University degree or program certificate; OR ten (10) years related experience and/or training; OR equivalent combination of education and experience.
Five (5) years’ experience in either Law Enforcement, Department of Corrections, Federal/commercial security, or the United States Armed Forces.
Minimum of at least five (5) years’ experience in security management or program management, with a minimum of two (2) years in a supervisory role within the government contracting/security sector.
Must have at least one of the following: Experience in a State licensed security services occupation or be a current or former member (honorable discharge) of the United States Armed Forces.
Strong understanding of federal regulations, compliance requirements and security operations.
Proven track record in managing large-scale security programs, exceptional problem-solving abilities, and experience with advanced security technologies.
Experience supporting government programs/contracts within the Intelligence Community (IC).
Demonstrated ability to interact professionally, effectively, and successfully with individuals at all levels of an organization, building strong relationships, and communicating with confidence and respect.
Experience in providing mentoring/coaching in order to improve performance of those you manage/lead.
Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated proficiency and a working knowledge of company policies and procedures, and how to interpret and implement/administer them.
Ability to successfully utilize Customer specific databases/tools.
Understanding of Employee (W-2) and Independent Contractor (1099) models.
Virginia DCJS Licensed or able to obtain.

What Desired Skills You'll Bring

Best security practices as they relate to critical security infrastructure.
Experience working in a data center.
Previous experience working with/managing a diverse workforce of government, contractor, and commercial employees.
Proficient in Microsoft Office products including MS Word, Excel, and Power Point.
Experience in obtaining, analyzing, interpreting, and delivering metrics in order to make process changes when appropriate.
Experience in preparing reports and delivering both informal and formal briefings to a wide audience.

An active Top Secret SCI w/Polygraph security clearance is required for this position.

Broadcom ITMS
Account management

NetBackup
OnTAP storage management

Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) configuration, management, and end-user support
Horizon Management

CCIC2S mission software configuration, deployment, and monitoring
SPO Chief Scientist Office system and software support
Atlassian Suite management
Virtual Cloud Foundation (VCF)
Dell VxRail deployment
Experience leading or coordinating operations teams, managing schedules, and serving as a primary operational point of contact.

Strong documentation, communication, and coordination skills to support reporting, PWS deliverables, and stakeholder engagement.

to join our team.

Our assignments range from complex multi-stream development programmes and business technology transformations to organizational change, and interim leadership roles.

In this role, you will help customers clarify direction, structure ambiguous situations, improve ways of working, and turn strategic goals into practical execution. You will work closely with business and IT stakeholders, build bridges between different parts of the organization, and lead change in a hands-on and pragmatic way.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in leading large-scale development initiatives and transformation programmes, acting as a trusted sparring partner for both executives and employees, and helping organizations move in the right direction. You are comfortable moving between strategic advisory, programme leadership and hands-on execution depending on the customer’s needs, maturity and scale.

We provide a structured onboarding and role-specific training phase to ensure you are set up for success before stepping into customer assignments.

Leading business operations development, transformation and change initiatives in customer organizations

Leading complex programmes, projects and multi-stream development initiatives

Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel
Strong references and a proven ability to create customer value

Challenging customer assignments across a wide range of environments, from large international companies to purpose-driven public organisations.
